newsitem.title: ERITREA: Eritrean refugees to resume returning from Sudan.
newsitem.headline: Eritrean refugees to resume returning from Sudan.

text.p: The organised repatriation of Eritrean refugees from Sudan will resume early in 1997 after a break of more than one year, the U.N. said on Monday.
"There is a solution. The political obstacle which has stopped repatriation for the last 13 months has been removed," UNHCR chief in Eritrea Arnulv Torbjornsen told Reuters.
"Both governments have taken a step forward for the benefit of the refugees," said Torbjornsen, adding: "The Eritrean president is very eager to have the refugees come home."
UNHCR says there are 132,000 Eritrean refugees in camps and settlements inside Sudan plus about 100,000 refugees in Sudanese towns and cities. A pilot repatriation programe ended in June 1995.
